core_obligations: Prove the easy direction: if X is geometrically connected over k then the base change X_{k'} is geometrically connected over k', straight from the definition via further base change (proof lines 719-720).

Produce a common extension for an arbitrary test field: given any field extension k''/k, invoke the existence of a common extension k'''/k' and k'''/k'' so that the base changes of X may be compared over one field (proof lines 720-723).

Transport connectedness downwards: the base change morphism X_{k'''} -> X_{k''} is surjective because it is the base change of the surjective morphism of spectra of fields, so connectedness of X_{k'''} implies connectedness of X_{k''}; as k'' was arbitrary, the geometric connectedness of X_{k'} over k' descends to X over k, giving the converse (proof lines 723-728).
proof_roadmap: The forward implication is immediate from the definition by composing base changes (proof lines 719-720).
For the converse, take an arbitrary field extension k''/k and choose a common extension k''' fitting over both k' and k'' (proof lines 720-723).

Use surjectivity of X_{k'''} -> X_{k''} as a base change of a surjection of spectra of fields to deduce connectedness of X_{k''} from that of X_{k'''}, whence X is geometrically connected over k (proof lines 723-728).
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a scheme X over a field k and any field extension k'/k, X is geometrically connected over k exactly when the base change X_{k'} is geometrically connected over k' (statement lines 712-715). The forward direction is immediate; the converse is the content, and it cannot be done by a single base change because the test fields k'' are unrelated to k'. The proof therefore installs a common extension k''' dominating both k' and k'', and uses surjectivity of the base-changed morphism X_{k'''} -> X_{k''} - which holds because it is a base change of the surjection between spectra of fields - to push connectedness down from k''' to k'' (proof lines 721-727). The claim is H2: one structural idea, short verification.
